Container.Name: riven-frontend
Container.Overview: [b][span style='color: #E2211C;']🚀 CRITICAL INITIAL SETUP:[/span][/b][br][br] [b]1. Generate Keys:[/b] Visit [url=https://riven.tv/generator]https://riven.tv/generator[/url] to create your API Key and Auth Secret.[br] [b]2. First Login:[/b] Enter your [b]Plex Username[/b] in the Admin field and set [b]ENABLE_PLEX_SIGNUP[/b] to [b]true[/b]. [br] [b]3. Browser Security:[/b] If accessing via HTTP, you MUST enable the Chrome flag: [i]chrome://flags/#unsafely-treat-insecure-origin-as-secure[/i] and add this IP:3000 to the list, or login will fail.

Config.Name: ORIGIN
Config.Description: The full URL used to access this page. Must match your browser address bar exactly. No trailing slash.

Config.Name: BACKEND_URL
Config.Description: The internal IPv4 address of the Riven-Backend container.

Config.Name: BACKEND_API_KEY
Config.Description: 32-char hex key from riven.tv/generator. Must match Backend API key.

Config.Name: RIVEN_ADMIN_USER
Config.Description: Your Plex username (case-sensitive) to grant admin rights on first login.

Config.Name: ENABLE_PLEX_SIGNUP
Config.Description: Set to 'true' for the first login to allow account creation.
